topic: Analytics data sharing and frequency updates
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered the availability of a new dataset containing dwell time metrics. The dataset, named `aka_test_1`, was shared on dev-analytics.allunite.com and covers the period from 01.01.2024 to 26.08.2024. Later in the day, a request was made regarding frequency data for 'ocean'. This task was scheduled to be completed after an upcoming meeting.

Additionally, several sets of location and frequency data points were exchanged.
decisions: The new dwell time dataset (`aka_test_1`) is available on dev-analytics.allunite.com for analysis.
action_items: Someone needs to review the shared dwell time dataset.
Frequency data for 'ocean' will be provided after an upcoming meeting.
